entry.title: New: Bill 2972 (Kauaʻi) — In Committee
entry.content:
For An Ordinance Amending Chapter 16, Kaua‘i County Code 1987, As Amended, Relating To The Traffic Code, creating necessary definitions for emerging technologies and an accompanying new section to Chapter 16 that addresses electric bicycles or e-bikes and their safe, allowable use on public roads, thereby reducing the frequency and severity of e-bike-related incidents

Latest action: On agenda 2025-10-29
